text: I can explain why billing and metrics must use event-time windows and what goes wrong with processing time during a backlog or replay.
I can calculate window updates and open state for tumbling and sliding windows (size ÷ slide) and propose pre-aggregation when it is too large.
I can compute a bounded-out-of-orderness watermark, say when a window fires, and diagnose a stuck watermark caused by an idle partition.
I can choose between dropping, updating and diverting late events and design a sink that accepts window updates.
I can explain how checkpoints plus a replayable source and an idempotent or transactional sink give exactly-once effects, and what latency that adds.
I can pick Flink, Kafka Streams or a nightly batch job for a given requirement and justify it.
